provenance.schedule: Frozen fixture order; baseline first on odd-numbered cases, candidate first on even
provenance.fixtureAuthorBoundary: Independently authored metadata held out from implementation/test authors; author saw specification and audited implementation; not blinded
omissions: Local database paths and operational authorization/policy bindings
Full distractor corpus snapshots: deterministic source recipe, corpus hashes and source-bound targets retained
Full selection/ranking inputs and HTTP envelopes: trace summaries, output refs, usage/accounting and raw artifact hashes retained
Incremental private checkpoints: raw artifact hashes retained
provenance.hashEncoding: Corpus and input hashes use UTF-8 JSON.stringify(value), retained array order, no trailing newline. Artifact hashes use original file bytes.
provenance.hashLimit: Hashes bind private omitted artifacts; public export alone cannot reconstruct those artifacts.
provenance.corpusRecipe: In each separate store, explicitly admit size-targets.length distractors first, content = distractorPrefix + ' ' + one-based ordinal + '.', followed by targets in fixture order; synthetic user receipts repeat the content. File distractors under AAA Archive, targets under ZZZ Target topic or ZZZ Recipes for misfiled; unfiled targets remain unfiled. UUIDs and timestamps are generated independently per store.

accounting.note: Known usage excludes unknown-cost calls and is not the total bill. Conservative reservations are not refunded.
